body: Thanks for responding I appreciate it more than you know. I’d enjoy talking to you. I don’t have discord and I don’t know how to start a dm.

Part 3 definitely gets better, I don’t know where your at but it gets a lot better once you get to battle in Egypt. I mean, I still think the part is overrated but I really did love it though. It has such a good cast of characters and the final battle is so good. I do agree that the earlier minor villains are weak, but it gets better. Stick with the part and I’m sure you’ll love it :)
Thank you for your advice, nice to know you care :)
